Percentage chance per fireable tick to skip the attack — a 100% hit rate is the exact stat anticheats correlate. IMPORTANT for safety: a miss sends NO packet at all (no swing, no attack, no slot swap). The anticheat sees literally nothing that tick — no wall-swing, no air-swing, no unpaired swing packet, so this can't cause a flag on its own. The only cost is the ~100ms internal cooldown before the next attempt, which is what humanizes the attack-packet cadence. 5–15% is a plausible human miss rate.

Filters candidate targets to those inside this angular cone from your view at ACQUISITION time (degrees). Retention is still governed by Max Yaw — a target acquired at 30° that drifts past this cone stays locked while it remains within Max Yaw, so tighten this to prefer front-of-view targets without losing them mid-fight.
Ignore = hit through the shield (0.5x dmg, target still guarded). Skip = don't attack while the shield is up. Prefer Axe = silent-swap to a hotbar axe for the disable-shield hit, then auto-restore.
